mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy cycle, which reduces discount rates applied to equity cash flows, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) during the easing period, or the decline in FEDFUNDS is not sustained over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden increase in the federal funds rate above 4.2% triggers a sharp sell-off in equities as investors anticipate higher inflation and tighter policy, leading to negative 5-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: 20d returns remain non-negative despite FEDFUNDS crossing above 4.2%, or the rate increase is not sustained beyond the trigger point.

mechanism_narrative: Rising unemployment benefits claims (PAYEMS) and a concurrent increase in labor force participation (UNRATE) signal a strengthening labor market, boosting corporate profits and equity valuations, resulting in positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: 20d returns are not significantly positive when both proxies rise above thresholds, or the correlation between proxies and returns is weak (R² < 0.15).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in the industrial production index below 100 indicates weakening supply-side demand, leading to reduced corporate earnings growth and negative 60-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: INDPRO recovers above 100 without corresponding negative returns, or returns revert to positive within 60 days despite prolonged supply contraction.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in personal consumption (GDPC1) and business investment (RSAFS) signals robust demand across sectors, driving up equity valuations and generating positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: 20d returns are not significantly positive when both demand proxies surge, or the proxies' correlation with returns is weak (R² < 0.25).

mechanism_narrative: During a sustained monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 4.2%), higher interest rates compress equity discount rates, leading to negative 20-day S&P 500 forward returns as investors anticipate lower growth.
failure_condition: 20d returns remain positive despite FEDFUNDS in tightening, or the rate increase is not sustained over the period.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in industrial production (INDPRO) reflects improved supply chain efficiency and manufacturing activity, enhancing corporate earnings and driving positive 5-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: INDPRO's upward trend does not correlate with positive returns (p > 0.05 in t-test), or the trend reverses before the horizon.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden spike in unemployment claims (PAYEMS) above 154342 triggers a sell-off in equities as investors fear labor market instability, leading to negative 60-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: PAYEMS crosses above threshold without UNRATE dropping, or returns do not turn negative within 60 days despite the claim surge.
